## Classification and affected revision
Hosted CI reproduction + exact-source diagnosis; no independent local full-suite reproduction. PR #192 at `14ef9efbc795031a1df0890d116055b4f6da5b82` updates the dev PM toolchain from 2026.10.24 to 2026.10.25.

## Reproduction / actual result
The registered-command test [test/coverage-gaps.test.ts:326–364](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-brief/blob/14ef9efbc795031a1df0890d116055b4f6da5b82/test/coverage-gaps.test.ts#L326-L364) reaches its quiet-output case:
`run({ format: "text", output: quietPath }, ["2999-01-01"])`.
It expects `ok: true` and `truncated: false`, but invokes:
`pm --pm-path <isolated-tracker> activity --json --full --from 2999-01-01 --limit 1000`.
The host exits 2 with `invalid_argument_value`, detail `Activity --from must be before --to`, rejected field `--from`.

Same failure appears in all four current-head jobs:
- [Node 22 test](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-brief/actions/runs/40771925357/job/123111079481)
- [Node 26 test](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-brief/actions/runs/40771925357/job/123111079561)
- [npm release gate](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-brief/actions/runs/40771925357/job/123111079572)
- [Bun release gate](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-brief/actions/runs/40771925357/job/123111079084)

## Diagnosis and impact
This fixture uses a future lower bound to manufacture an empty activity window; that is incompatible with the host's bounded-window validation. It blocks toolchain-update CI and release qualification. The npm/Bun failures are downstream coverage failures, not four independent defects or evidence of a Bun runtime problem. [readActivitySince](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-brief/blob/14ef9efbc795031a1df0890d116055b4f6da5b82/index.ts#L2766-L2780) does forward an explicit `to`; the quiet test simply supplies none. No normal valid-window runtime regression is established.

## Goal / expected behavior
The accepted [delta brief item pm-brief-da2c](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-brief/blob/14ef9efbc795031a1df0890d116055b4f6da5b82/.agents/pm/features/pm-brief-da2c.toon) requires tested delta/empty-window behavior and passing release checks. The existing [coverage item pm-brief-gtiy](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-brief/blob/14ef9efbc795031a1df0890d116055b4f6da5b82/.agents/pm/issues/pm-brief-gtiy.toon) requires meaningful observable behavior with stable npm/Bun execution, not weakened coverage.

## Acceptance / regression criteria
- Replace the invalid future-window shortcut with an isolated, deterministic, valid empty activity window while retaining file-output, successful receipt, and `truncated: false` assertions.
- Separately assert invalid/reversed-window rejection if that behavior needs coverage; do not weaken host validation or suppress errors to satisfy this test.
- Rerun the targeted registered-command case and the Node 22/26 coverage plus npm/Bun release gates on the repaired immutable head; retain any unrelated incomplete gates.

All-status issues/PRs and linked canonical records were checked. #187 tracks a Daily Release failure on a different default-branch revision/run; this evidence is specifically the PR192 quiet-output fixture, not a claim to diagnose #187. No implementation edits or publication performed.
